notes.title: Announcement about future update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29075793/a6b63ca98e4490b133385a0cbab91503ec51e23d.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone. I want to leave a short notes for you.

I know the game didn't had update for a while, but in my soul I want to keep this game update so much.
But I can't do it right now. I have to do a jobs to live.

But I promise, when I have enough money to take care myself. I will put a lot of update to this game for sure.

Thank you all!

By the way I'm online all the time you can still talk with me on any platform.
